exams.name: Aircraft Dispatcher Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on meteorology, flight planning, performance and regulations required for the FAA aircraft dispatcher certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for pilots who already hold an ATP certificate and are adding a rotorcraft-helicopter category and class rating.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test allowing holders of a Canadian airline transport helicopter licence to obtain the equivalent FAA certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test covering helicopter aerodynamics, performance, weather and air carrier operations for the ATP rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question conversion test for Canadian airline transport pilots seeking an FAA multiengine airplane ATP certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 125-question four-hour test on transport-category performance, meteorology, crew resource management and Part 121 operations.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Single Engine Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian licence holders adding an FAA single-engine airplane airline transport pilot certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Single Engine Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 90-question test covering advanced aerodynamics, weather, navigation and regulations for a single-engine airplane ATP certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian commercial pilot aeroplane licence into an FAA commercial pilot certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on commercial privileges, complex aircraft systems, performance charts and Part 135 rules for paid flying.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on lighter-than-air airship aerodynamics, ballonets, ground handling and commercial operating rules.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Balloon Gas Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering gas balloon systems, ballast management, weather and commercial privileges for balloon pilots.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Balloon Hot Air Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on hot air balloon envelopes, burners, launch site selection and carrying passengers for compensation.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on soaring meteorology, tow procedures, glider performance and commercial operating limitations.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test covering autorotation, rotor systems, gyroplane performance and commercial pilot privileges in rotorcraft.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian commercial helicopter licence to an FAA commercial pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on helicopter performance, weight and balance, external loads and commercial rotorcraft operating rules.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Reciprocating Engine Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for existing flight engineers adding a reciprocating engine class rating to their certificate.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Reciprocating Engine Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on piston powerplants, aircraft systems and performance for the flight engineer reciprocating engine rating.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turbojet Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for certificated flight engineers adding a turbojet class rating to an existing certificate.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turbojet Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test covering turbine engines, pressurisation, hydraulics and electrical systems for turbojet flight engineers.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turboprop Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for flight engineers adding a turbopropeller class rating to a certificate already held.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turboprop Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on turbopropeller powerplants, propeller control and transport aircraft systems for flight engineer applicants.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Airplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for instructors holding a CFI certificate in another category who are adding an airplane rating.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on flight training procedures, stall and spin awareness, endorsements and instructor responsibilities for airplane CFIs.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Glider Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for existing flight instructors adding a glider category rating to their instructor certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test covering glider instruction techniques, tow signals, soaring weather and student endorsements.
